name: Keisetsu
message: 「Phew, this is a nuisance...」
She finished her calls with the various parties and murmured to herself.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Typical of a foreign firm. Once they make a decision, they move fast.」
Information had come in that a major company under the <d0076>Ookami Family</d>, a branch of the Kazamine Group, was the target of a hostile takeover.
She had contacted the relevant parties and arranged for the Kazamine Family to take the lead in organizing a white knight defense.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「But I find it hard to believe they’ll just give up now...」
Their opponent was over three times the size of the entire Kazamine Group in total assets. They would undoubtedly try something else.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Heh, fine by me. If they want to make an enemy of me, I’ll make sure they learn exactly what that entails—thoroughly.」
She would exhaust every possible avenue and break them in so completely that they would never want to lay a finger on her business again.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Even so, it’s tough doing this from here.」
She had managed this time, but there was a limit to how many missions she could handle remotely from the academy.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...I suppose it’s almost time to make a choice.」
The credentials gained from graduating from Murakumo Academy were something she wanted, if only to stabilize her social standing.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Well, not that I think academic credentials actually matter...」
...but they were better to have than not, if only to manipulate people who couldn't judge a person's worth beyond the labels stuck to them.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I’ve mapped out the relationships among the faculty. All that’s left is to keep this information updated.」
There was much about the faculty's personal dynamics that couldn't be understood without being on the inside, and coming to the academy had paid off handsomely.
Now, using this information, she would gradually expand her influence by installing teachers under the Kazamine thumb.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Well, I’ve done what I needed to do at the academy.」
At this point, there was little reason left for her to stay.
Considering her future operations, she wouldn't mind taking a leave of absence or even quitting the academy entirely.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Still, I do worry about Setsugekka...」
She still couldn't control her berserk states, and the Martial Festival was steadily approaching.
As she had already known, the cohesion of the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association, centered around the Suzakuin, was rock-solid and not easily shattered.
Why was the Suzakuin Family, which championed independence and self-reliance, able to forge such a tight-knit alliance?
It came down to one thing: their strength as swordsmen.
The legend of the "lineage of the strongest swordsmen," which no one can deny, is what gives the Suzakuin Family its dominance.
And the symbol of that strength is the title of Toujinegi.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If Kazamine claims the seat of Toujinegi, the tide will turn. It will blow a hole right through the Suzakuin era of sole supremacy.」
Factoring in Tamukai as well, Kazamine has never had a swordsman with as much hidden potential as Setsugekka.
In all likelihood, another swordsman with the caliber to reach the Suzakuin will never be born into Kazamine again.
This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, and I intend to seize it at any cost.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Which is precisely why I cannot afford to leave her side, and yet...」
Do I choose my practical duties, or the grand dream that Setsugekka might build for us? It is truly a vexing dilemma.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Now then, what should I do... Oh？」
Suddenly, I spotted a small figure approaching.

name: Miyako
message: 「...Ah, from Takamura Class」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hello, Miyako-san.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Hello, Kazamine Keisetsu-san.」
Come to think of it, this girl is a Suzakuin too. Getting close and winning her over might prove useful to Kazamine.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Out for a walk by yourself？ What are you up to？」

name: Miyako
message: 「I'm running an errand right now.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「An errand？ For Momiji-san？」

name: Miyako
message: 「No, for Mr. Fox. He said he really, really wants some inari sushi from <d0095>Toyohara Konpeidou</d>.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Is that so? What a good girl.」

name: Keisetsu
message: （...Sh-She's an even more peculiar child than I thought.）
While hesitating over whether I should really keep getting involved with her, I put on a pleasant smile.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Aren't you thirsty? If you'd like, I can treat you to something.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Really？ Then I want a matcha smoothie.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「S-Sure thing.」
Her tastes are surprisingly mature...

name: Miyako
message: 「Mm... mm, ahhh...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Well? Is it good?」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yeah, thank you, Keisetsu-san.」
There was a smoothie shop nearby, so I bought a matcha smoothie and gave it to Miyako-san.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Miyako-san, you ran away from your home at the Suzakuin estate, didn't you？ Was there something you were unhappy about？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yeah, Father told me to try using a spirit blade, and I ended up breaking it. So then Father got mad.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Oh, what kind of blade was it?」

name: Miyako
message: 「It was made about 500 years ago, and Momiji-oneechan said it was a masterpiece worth about a billion yen.」

name: Miyako
message: 「I’m the one who broke it. When I put my power into it, the blade just went *pop* and shattered.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Th-that might be only natural for him to be angry at you for...」

name: Miyako
message: 「But Father was the one who told me to try using it. I just did exactly what I was told.」

name: Miyako
message: 「I couldn't accept that, so I ran away from home.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I see, that sounds like it was tough.」
It was likely because she poured in enough spirit power to exceed the spirit blade's potential.
In other words, this Suzakuin Miyako naturally possesses a spiritual resonance value equal to or greater than that of Setsugekka when she is in a berserk state.

name: Keisetsu
message: （Truly, the depths of the Suzakuin family are unfathomable...）

name: Keisetsu
message: 「By the way, Miyako-san, do you have any dreams for the future?」

name: Miyako
message: 「My dream is world conquest.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「World...！？ O-oh, that’s a big dream.」

name: Miyako
message: 「But Momiji-oneechan looked like she didn't like that, so I don't think I'll go through with conquering the world.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Right now, I find it fun to go and meet strong people to fight, so I think I’ll just keep doing that.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I see, so you are indeed a swordswoman yourself.」
It made me realize once again that, despite being so small, she is still a Suzakuin.

name: Miyako
message: 「Keisetsu-san, why don't you do Jindou？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Fufu, I am weak, you see.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Is that so？ I think you're stronger than Setsugekka-san, though. But you seem timid, so maybe it doesn't really suit you.」
I found myself frozen in place. This child... she is far sharper than I had imagined.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That's right. I found other paths more suited to me than the way of the sword—paths I wanted to pursue.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That is why I leave the way of the sword to Setsugekka.」

name: Miyako
message: 「If you don't, Setsugekka-san won't have anything going for her, right? You’re surprisingly kind, Keisetsu-san.」
...Ah, this girl is beyond help.
Would it be beneficial for Kazamine if I got close to her and brought her into the fold？ Don't be ridiculous. This girl is far too dangerous.

name: Miyako
message: 「Well, I’m in the middle of an errand, so I’ll be going now.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Yes, I see.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Thanks for the smoothie.」
Just as I thought she had taken a step away, Miyako-san turned back around.

name: Miyako
message: 「Oh, right. I actually really like Momiji-oneesan and Setsugekka-san.」

name: Miyako
message: 「The two of you are always having so much fun together. I’ve never seen Momiji-oneesan like that before.」

name: Miyako
message: 「I’m sure you two could become great friends.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hehe, I hope so.」

name: Miyako
message: 「So, Keisetsu-san, you shouldn’t do anything too mean.」
It felt as if a cold blade had been pressed against me.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...I’ll take that as a word of advice.」

name: Miyako
message: 「See you then~」
With those words, Miyako-san departed.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Hehe, what a fascinating girl.」
I let out a wry smile as I watched her receding figure.
She surely sees something that no one else can. That is what sustains her extraordinary talent and intellect.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Suzakuin Miyako... I would very much like to be on good terms with you.」
She is a <d0077>child prodigy</d> that even the Suzakuin family itself cannot fully control. If she were to become an enemy, Kazamine would undoubtedly be crushed.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Damned if I do, damned if I don’t... the road ahead is fraught with difficulty.」
It is not an easy path. I knew that from the start. That is exactly why it is worth doing.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Now then, shall we head back to the others?」
When I opened the hologram to contact Setsugekka, a single notification had arrived.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「An encrypted email, how rare. Who could it be?」
I decrypted the mail using Kazamine's proprietary encryption routine, and...

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Eh, Makinojou Kazamine-san...！？」
It was a direct email to me from the current head of the Kazamine family, Makinojou—
